en: "I FOUND A RELIIIIIC!"{w}
"What? Is that true?"{w}
"But it got STOLEEEEEN!! Those little brats-s-s!!"{w}
"...What is the meaning of this, Zeshrom?"{w}
"It seems Donnelkral found the relic, then ran into some adventurers.{w}There was a fight, and I'm told the relic was taken."{w}
note: Subject of the pro-drop clause made explicit as Donnelkral (the one who found it, row 3734); 'they' would be read as the adventurers.

en: "...And I hear Nonhared had one taken as well. Is that not so?"{w}
note: Refers back to slice_014 row 3716-3720 (Nonhared lost a relic). No pronoun for Nonhared. Accuracy: tag 'did I not?' (questioning her own hearing) changed to 'Is that not so?' -- sou dewa nai ka presses Zeshrom to confirm the report.

en: "Yes, my deepest apologies.{w}Most likely it was the same people this time, too."{w}
"What dependable subordinates you have."{w}
note: Sarcasm, answered by Donnelkral's 'Is that a dig!?'.

en: "Is that a dig!? You are SO damn annoyiiing!! If I'd just had a bellyful of meat, those punks would've been NOTHING!!"{w}{p}"GRGAAAAAAH! This is so frustratiiiiiing!! I'll rip the lot of you to shreds, GOGAAAAAH!!"{w}
note: Shout-voice kept with stretched vowels. 'omaera goto' = 'all of you along with them', rendered 'the lot of you'.

en: "Enough, shut up! A loser has no right to speak!!{w}You're confined to quarters until further notice!!"{w}
"HIGYAAAAAAHN!?"{w}
"Good-for-nothing...{w}Forgive the disturbance, Lady Urna."{w}
note: Urna-sama from Zeshrom = 'Lady Urna' (Urna is female per glossary; Zeshrom is courtly toward her).

en: "You said adventurers. Why can some common riffraff track down a relic? Do they have something that surpasses my own senses?"{w}
"About that... The truth is..."{w}
"To think we've had this many relics taken from us..."{w}
note: New scene: Zeshrom alone, Escapra arrives.

en: "Starting to panic now, of all times?"{w}
"Escapra. What of your relic search...{w}Don't tell me -- you too!?"{w}

"Pretty much. Those adventurers, you know the ones? I saw the light of that compass thing of theirs, so I tailed them, and out popped a relic."{w}{p}"What the hell is going on? Wasn't the whole idea that we'd have the edge in the search, with a materialized Urna right there with us?"{w}
note: 'Ittai dou natte iru n da' given as 'What the hell is going on?' to match Escapra's coarse voice.

en: "...That was how it was supposed to go."{w}
"Can't we use one ourselves? Those adventurers we toyed with a while back had something like it, didn't they?"{w}
note: 'one' = a compass (row 3776 answers about the compass).

en: "Galling as it is, it seems the compass can't be used unless the gods have acknowledged you."{w}
"Ah, so that's how it is. Doesn't miss a trick, this Dehain or whatever.{w}By the way..."{w}
note: Dehain's gender unknown; phrased without a pronoun.

en: "You haven't forgotten, have you?{w}If the plan succeeds, we set Urna up as Zefkaka, make this land ours, and that's that."{w}{p}"If it fails, we dump Urna and take the power, at the very least."{w}{p}"Even if it's only a quarter of its original strength, we'd still be getting our hands on a Zefkaka's power.{w}We could run even wilder than we do now."{w}
note: Zefkaka kept capitalized per glossary even in role use ('set Urna up as Zefkaka', 'a Zefkaka's power'); see report.

en: "...Hmph. And here I wondered what you'd say.{w}That is the contract, so that is how it will go."{w}
"Kukuku... Let's hope so."{w}

"I've got no interest in you yourself.{w}...But we agreed to split the reward down the middle. You understand that?"{w}{p}"If you're thinking of setting us up, I'm free to get rid of you.{w}Don't you forget that, hmm?"{w}
"And don't you forget the contract made between us of Espel-Dex and Animacie. It's your master who'll be in trouble."{w}
note: New name: Animacie (Animashie in Hepburn; Escapra's master). '-dono' dropped rather than guessing Lord/Lady; gender unknown.

en: "The part about helping you look for relics? You never said we actually had to get them, right?{w}We've helped plenty already."{w}
note: 'shingu nyuushu no zehi wa towanai' = whether the relics are obtained is not a condition.

en: "There's still the clause that you lend us your strength if the worst happens."{w}{p}"You may do as you please for a while, but if it comes to that, you will be coming back."{w}
"Ha! Go say that to that thrill-seeking woman of yours."{w}
note: 'douraku onna' (pleasure-seeking/dilettante woman) in Zeshrom's camp; most likely Mistress (who runs arena games for fun), not named here. Source says woman (onna).

en: "...You failed again?"{w}
"Ah, Lady Urna."{w}

"Sorry 'bout that. It's been the same since Nonhared's go: we're always a step behind."{w}{p}"Honestly. A certain Zefkaka only meets two of the conditions -- how unprepared can you get?"{w}{p}"Nothing in her head but wrath and vengeance? And she calls herself the Earth Goddess. What a joke.{w}Kakakaka!!"{w}
note: 'dokozo no Zefkaka' = a veiled jab at Urna, so 'a certain Zefkaka'; 'her' used since the referent is Urna (female). 'daichi no megami ga kiite akireru' = 'calls herself the Earth Goddess -- what a joke'. Conditions = the relics held (2).

en: "...Hm? Wrath and vengeance?"{w}
"...You wretch. One more insolent word and I, Zeshrom, will not let it pass."{w}
"Ooh, scary, scary!"{w}
"I don't quite follow, but I do know that every last one of you is useless.{w}Next time, I'll go myself."{w}
"No, it would be best not to.{w}What do you intend to do if you run into humans or elves?"{w}
"Well then, I'll leave the rest to youuu.{w}Kukuku...{w}...Zeshrom, don't go getting any funny ideas, hmm?"{w}
note: 'yoroshiku na-' drawn-out vowel rendered as 'youuu'.

en: "Funny ideas?{w}Hahaha, what's this, Zeshrom? Are you going to betray me too?"{w}
"N-Never! Please, forget anything Escapra said!"{w}
"It was a joke. ...Well. A joke, I suppose."{w}
note: Deliberately uncertain repeat kept.

en: "...Lady Urna.{w}About the earlier matter... I will go, so please, wait here."{w}{p}"I don't believe there is any need for you to have further dealings with the people of this land..."{w}
note: 'the earlier matter' = Urna's 'Next time, I'll go myself' (row 3812).

en: "Are you worried? That I'll have a change of heart?"{w}{p}"According to Contrachio, my heart has no forgiveness in it -- no compassion.{w}So there's nothing to worry about, is there?"{w}{p}"I, Urna, am not so soft as to show mercy to traitors.{w}Yes... perhaps I'll bring back their heads."{w}
note: 'jiai' = 'compassion', matching Shield of Compassion. Contrachio judges a zefkaka's conditions, so 'According to Contrachio'.

en: "Tell me something, Zeshrom.{w}Which relics remain in my hands? Name them."{w}
"The Sword of Wrath and... ...an earring. Those two."{w}
note: Zeshrom hesitates to name the earring.

en: "An earring of what?"{w}
"That is... well..."{w}
"The tentacle woman said something odd just now. Haven't you told them properly?{w}About the relics that remain with me."{w}
note: 'shokushu onna' = Escapra. 'them' = the other hunters.

en: "I did... explain it...{w}But I told them that what you hold is the Sword of Wrath and...{w}the Earring of Vengeance."{w}
"...Why did you tell them a lie?"{w}
"Because wherever one goes...{w}there are those who delight in rubbing salt into others' wounds...{w}base, vulgar sorts..."{w}
note: Sentence cut at the same points as the source; 'yue' (because) moved to the front for English order.

en: "...Don't tell me you were protecting me?"{w}
"...I overstepped my place.{w}I apologize."{w}
"Heh heh... I'm not angry. I don't mind it.{w}...But spare me your needless concern.{w}If they want to sneer, let them."{w}
note: 'warukunai' rendered 'I don't mind it' (she is pleased).

en: "...I believe that you, and no other, are worthy of being the Earth Goddess."{w}{p}"That is precisely why we must win this battle, so that under your protection, the Kin of Darkness may flourish..."{w}
note: Interrupted by Urna; trailing kept.

en: "Ugh, enough.{w}I've heard that speech countless times!{w}...I'm going. Hold the fort while I'm gone."{w}
"Should I really just let her go like this...{w}...Nngh.{w}Honestly, what am I even doing?"{w}
"Damn it! Damn it...!! Them... they bit the hand that fed them... Damn it all...!!"{w}
note: Scene after Urna's own failed outing. 'aitsura' = the adventurers / people of this land. 'on wo ada de kaesu' = repay kindness with harm, rendered with the English idiom.

en: "I can only imagine how you must feel..."{w}
"Shut up!{w}What could any of you know about me... what could you..."{w}
"Ah... Lady Urna!?"{w}
"Shut up! Don't follow me!"{w}
"...Got a minute?"{w}

"...That makes four of the six relics already in their hands."{w}{p}"Mistress isn't here, but{w}if Mistress screwed up too, the fifth is theirs as well."{w}{p}"If it comes to that... you know what happens, right?"{w}
note: 'aitsu' = Mistress; name repeated instead of a pronoun (gender not stated). 'moshimo no toki' = the fallback plan in row 3782 (dump Urna, take the power).

en: "...I'll go next."{w}
"Huh? You?"{w}
"Yes. Partly to take responsibility, too.{w}I'll kill every last one of them.{w}Then all the relics will be ours."{w}
"Oh ho...{w}Then let's see what you can do."{w}
"So even you couldn't do it..."{w}
"At this point, it may be best to lie in wait for them at Contrachio."{w}
note: 'mukaeutsu' (written with a variant kanji) = intercept / meet the attack.

en: "Damn them... They won't rest until I'm..."{w}
note: Trailing source ('dou atte mo watashi wo...' = no matter what, me...) kept unfinished; English shaped as 'won't rest until I'm...'.

en: "Let us make the deepest level of Contrachio our base.{w}We will summon the mightiest forces that we of Espel-Dex can muster, and... Lady Urna?"{w}
"I won't forgive them... I will never forgive them..."{w}
"I cannot lose this battle.{w}Even if it costs me my life, I will be victorious!!"{w}{p}"Come, then, you ungrateful traitors...!!"{w}
You obtained {12:0003:0018}.{w}
note: Matches slice_000 'You obtained an item...' pattern.

en: You couldn't carry any more items.{w}
